messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: last week / MKL
parts:
Hi!

I won't be at the meeting on Tuesday, so just a heads-up:

- Enabling the MKL for Eigen is really simple to do and this should give Stan programs which use these routines which are directed to the MKL a performance advantage (i.e. cholseky decompositions, gemm operations)

- I did figure out how to build CVODES against the LAPACK interface of MKL and the result was an odd 50% slow down! I am still figuring out what is happening here; I have our MKL installation under suspicion. My next step is to build CVODES against OpenBLAS LAPACK and see what happens in this case... BTW, CVODES takes advantage of LAPACK (and not the MKL). There is even a LAPACK implementation from Apple. If this turns out to be useful it wont be limited to MKL owners.

- I haven't yet found the time to run Intel compiler and math tests, still need to do that.

- Finally I read rumors on 2.12... if so it would be great to consider the branch

https://github.com/stan-dev/math/tree/feature/issue-310-coupled_ode_system-refactor-only

for inclusion. Otherwise I suggest we postpone ODE refactoring until Paris where we should have a chance to all together discuss things.

Best,
Sebastian
